Let $n$ = number of rows

$$\dfrac{n}{2}\big(2 \times 3 + (n-1)3\big) = 828$$

$$n(3n+3) = 1656$$

$$3n(n+1) = 1656$$

$$n^2 + n = 552$$

$$n^2 + n - 552 = 0$$

$$n = \dfrac{-1 \pm \sqrt{1^2 - 4 \times -552}}{2}$$

$$= \dfrac{-1 \pm 47}{2}$$

$$= 23 \text{ (taking positive solution)}$$

There are 23 rows.

$$g(x) = k(x - m)^2 - 5$$

$$= k\left(x^2 - 2xm + m^2\right) - 5$$

$$= kx^2 - 2mkx + m^2k - 5$$

By inspection $k = 3$

By equating coefficient of $x$

$$2mk = 12$$

$$6m = 12$$

$$m = 2$$

ALTERNATE SOLUTION

$$g(x) = k(x - m)^2 - 5$$

$$g(x) = 3x^2 - 12x + 7$$

$$= 3\left(x^2 - 4x\right) + 7$$

$$= 3\left(x^2 - 4x + 4\right) + 7 - 12$$

$$= 3(x - 2)^2 - 5$$

So $k = 3$ and $m = 2$

$$x = \dfrac{1}{2}, \qquad \text{since } e^{-2x} \neq 0, \qquad f\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = \dfrac{1}{2}e^{-1} = \dfrac{1}{2e}$$
